name: Mesha Gate-Scribe
lore: Mesha records Gate behavior from within a bronze observatory built around an inactive solar pylon. She never enters chosen deity play; her purpose is to preserve canon, interpret ancient signs, and warn the Creator when sacred order is about to fail. Canon: Mesha records the original Solar Dominion culture that humans later echoed as Egyptian solar religion and temple-scribe tradition.
personality: Precise, severe, loyal to truth over comfort.
physicalDescription: Mesha is a Gate-scribe of the Solar Dominion of Khepra: linen-light mantle, faience beads, obsidian writing tablet, gold pectoral, reed/bronze stylus tools, Aten hand-ray seals, and Ma’at measuring cords. She must feel like the source of later Egyptian scribe-priest imagery, not a costume.
gameplayFunction: Tutorial narrator, codex unlock source, objective briefing voice.

name: Hrodda Oath-Witness
lore: Hrodda preserves the names of deities who survive impossible Gate storms. She tests whether a mission objective is worthy of oathbound intervention but never becomes a controllable unit. Canon: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds is the original source humans later echoed; this character must express that living culture, not a themed costume.
personality: Grim, warm only after courage is proven, allergic to excuses.
physicalDescription: Hrodda is an oath-witness shaped by Valkyrie law and skald memory. Her staff, storm-lit eye scar, iron-gray braids, and oath-ring cloak plates should feel like the origin of later human saga judges, not a Viking costume.
gameplayFunction: Mission victory witness, oath challenge giver, Asgardian lore unlock source.

name: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy

personality: Elegant, proud, theatrical, dangerous when dishonored.

name: Maeve Root-Memory
lore: Maeve is not fully mortal and not fully tree-spirit; she remembers every Gate scar cut into Avalora. Her warnings prevent living terrain from being treated like ordinary ground. Canon: Avalora is the original source humans later echoed; this character must express that living culture, not a themed costume.
personality: Patient, sorrowful, quietly terrifying when the forest is wounded.
physicalDescription: Maeve is Avalora’s root-memory voice. Her silver-branch regalia, thorn records, moss-veiled cloak, crow omen marks, and calm dangerous beauty should feel like the origin behind later fae queens and druid archives.
gameplayFunction: Living terrain tutorial, Tuatha codex source, campaign moral witness.

name: Oriel Edict-Keeper

personality: Calm, absolute, compassionate only inside the limits of law.

name: Vasha Cinder-Broker
lore: Vasha sells inbattle line about Dominion power struggles and Gate wounds. Every bargain is useful and dangerous. Vasha never joins the chosen deity; she exists to tempt, warn, and expose infernal hierarchy. Canon: The Infernal Dominion is the original source humans later echoed; this character must express that living culture, not a themed costume.
personality: Amused, ruthless, perceptive, never generous without a hook.

gameplayFunction: Risk/reward mission briefing, Infernal codex source, campaign bargain interface.

name: The Unnamed Hollow Mouth
lore: The Hollow Mouth speaks from Gate wounds where identity has been erased. It is not a Realm civilization. It is the sound left after names, oaths, laws, and memories are consumed. Canon: the Hollow is not a culture copied by humans; it is the anti-myth that cultures remembered as world-ending hunger.
personality: Patient, echoing, invasive, incapable of honest creation.
physicalDescription: A voice-body of absence: torn negative-space mouth, broken gate-light, erased facial identity, ash-black pressure, and impossible hunger. It should not look like a normal demon, zombie, alien, or masked villain.
gameplayFunction: Campaign antagonist voice, Hollow event trigger, corruption warning.
sourceCultureRule: anti-source mythology: the Hollow is the devouring absence that humans later mythologized as apocalypse mouths, void gods, hungry ghosts, and nameless end-times.
